ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 64
   D. 8

2. What is √81? (1 mark)

   D. 9

   A. 21

   A. 2/2

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13

   D. 17

25. Solve for x: x + 4 = 8. (1 mark)

30. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4
